head: codex/111-wp18c01-conversation-session-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-18C.01] Implement canonical human-agent conversation sessions
body:
Closes #111

## Summary
- add Runtime-owned bounded conversation sessions with recipient binding, deterministic turn ordering, idempotency, timeout, cancellation, and reconnect retrieval
- dispatch through canonical authenticated ingress and render only Runtime-authoritative correlated outcomes
- compose conversation eligibility with the live WP-18C.03 roster and recheck eligibility immediately before dispatch
- replay a pending turn at most once per actual disconnect while allowing recovery across repeated disconnects

## Validation
- conversation session tests: 1/1 PASS
- agent roster tests: 10/10 PASS
- control tests: 24/24 PASS
- OpenAPI tests: 6/6 PASS
- Observatory WSS tests: 7/7 PASS
- browser conversation and combined static Observatory contracts: PASS
- production-library Clippy with warnings denied, formatting, and diff hygiene: PASS

## Review
- independent exact-head review by subagent 019fef4f-e98a-7a13-a0dd-e401692cee98: APPROVED with no findings
- reviewed exact head: a101b23ec21a674e3cb3d7165061d8c83b0aa142

## Boundaries
- durable cross-restart conversation history remains owned by #114
- broader multi-agent room and routing semantics remain owned by #115 and #116
